description: Rules that cannot apply to a given model type are excluded from the audit-completion denominator. Decisions are logged and stored server-side only (data/rule-exclusions/); nothing is shown in the report. Exclusion is an exclude-list: a rule not named here always counts.

R_scope_decision_regulated_network.decision: Scope decision recorded 2026-10-03 at Mik Riazanov's instruction, after reviewing Fm-00032 and Fm-00033: these generic project-finance gates test structures (equity ownership split, retained-earnings roll-forward, cash waterfall and cash balance, capitalised vs cash interest, distributions vs cash, actual/forecast period flags) that a regulated-network allowed-revenue model does not contain. Both runs reported them absent. A rule still counts whenever a run reaches a Pass or Issue verdict on it.

R2_scope_decision_regulated_network_comm.decision: Scope decision recorded 2026-10-17 at Mik Riazanov's instruction, after the offline triage of the 48 core rules that never reached a verdict in Fm-00033 to Fm-00035: these generic procedures test commercial and project-finance mechanics (debt sweeps, reserve accounts, preferred returns, price x volume revenue, capacity limits, payroll build, bad debts, sub-annual conversion, GST/VAT, deferred revenue, IRR/NPV, no-debt and delayed-start stress tests) that a regulated-network allowed-revenue model does not contain. The fatal-gate members of this decision (cash waterfall, ownership split) are in the tier above.

R3_scope_decision_regulated_network_noti.decision: Scope decision recorded 2026-10-17 on Mik Riazanov's go-ahead to build the proposed scope changes after the offline pass over Fm-00036: in that run the reviewer itself reported that these structures (accruals and prepayments, equity capital flows, a balance sheet tolerance, construction/operations/exit lifecycle phases, covenant-style reverse and combined stress tests, sources and uses, a ramp-up curve, a master check sheet) have no equivalent in a notional-financing regulated network model.

R4_scope_decision_regulated_network_stat.decision: Scope decision recorded 2026-10-17 on Mik Riazanov's go-ahead to build the proposed scope changes after the offline pass over Fm-00036. These are fatal-gate tests and are kept in their own tier so they can be switched back on alone (set enabled to false): a notional-financing regulated network model does not produce a statutory balance sheet, a classified cash flow statement or a facility debt schedule (the reviewer reported exactly this for T2-S5-001, T2-S5-002 and T2-S6-001), so the generic gate has nothing to test.

R5_scope_decision_regulated_network_cond.decision: Scope decision recorded 2026-10-19 on Mik Riazanov's go-ahead after an independent review of the ESO licence model report (Fm-00036 era). The reviewer classed these procedures as not applicable to a regulated licence model: conditional project-finance or merchant-asset procedures (digital wholesale contracts, PPP contractor step-in, concession shareholder distress, index-linked debt instruments, ESCO ancillary benefits, generation outage and dispatch, fixed/variable cost split against a volume driver, construction WIP, statutory working-capital days) that the earlier reports answered with 'none present, no action required'. T2-S6-003 (DSCR structure) was added to the statutory-gates tier above for the same reason. A rule still counts whenever a run reaches a Pass or Issue verdict on it.
